name: secondbrain
description: Make SecondBrain your assistant's automatic long-term memory: a skill that recalls at the start of a task and saves durable facts, decisions, preferences, people, and events on its own, plus an auto-memory primer and the SecondBrain connection. Sign-in is a one-time browser login (OAuth, Apple/Google) — no token to paste — and works in Claude Code, Cowork, claude.ai, and the ChatGPT desktop app / Codex. Backed by your own private notes (Pro).
